description:
Tell another wave of matching workers about an open bounty. Once per bounty per day.
Use for: a bounty that needs more applicants. The reply says how many workers were put in line in this call, not how many messages arrived.
Not for: changing the bounty so more people fit (update_bounty).
Replies omit a field's sole empty value. If null is allowed, only null is omitted; false, [] and a present group stay. A present empty group is {}. Field descriptions explain unavailable values.
Example: invite_more_applicants({"bountyId":"b7Kq2mXw9TzR4nLp"})
Repeat: A repeat may act again on the thing as it stands then. Read it first.
Errors: forbidden, not_open, invited_recently; each error carries `fix`: what to do next.

bountyId.description: The bounty id, or a pasted rentahuman.ai/bounties/... link.

name: invite_more_applicants

queuedCount.description: Workers newly put in line for a message in this call. It is not a count of messages delivered: delivery happens after the call. get_bounty shows outreach.notifiedCount as it grows.

remainingCount.description: Room left under the outreach target after counting workers already told and messages queued or still being sent.

status.description: sent: workers were put in line for a message. target_reached: as many workers as the bounty aims for were already told. awaiting_delivery: earlier messages are still going out. queued: matching workers could not be looked up now; another try is set for later. exhausted: no new matching workers were found.

targetCount.description: How many workers the outreach aims to tell in all.

title: Invite more applicants
